summary: Tested 4 recently-added features on Snooker Parlour app. Backend: 5/5 pytest cases passed (walk-in paid, walk-in partial rejected w/o player, walk-in partial creates credit w/ player, add-player prorated billing, single-player table_payer_id at close). Frontend: Walk-in modal + Add Player mid-session work. Two UI-level issues found in Close & Bill flow (see below).

ui_bugs.issue: Per-Player Breakdown preview does NOT update when user selects a 'Table Paid By' player. After choosing 'Only TESTP1 pays for table', the rows still show split table_shares (0.37/0.37/0.15) instead of 0.89/0/0. Backend at close-time DOES apply table_payer_id correctly (verified via pytest), so the invoice is correct — but the cashier cannot see the effect in the preview and may lose trust in the feature.
ui_bugs.root_cause: useEffect(refresh, [..., tablePayerId]) calls GET /api/sessions/{sid}/preview-bill, but that endpoint's signature is (apply_membership_to_snacks, manual_discount) only — it never receives table_payer_id. So the recomputed billing is always the split-by-ratio version. Fix: add `table_payer_id: Optional[str]` query param to preview_bill and forward it into compute_session_billing via `_table_payer_id`, matching what close_session already does.

ui_bugs.issue: Console error: 'In HTML, <span> cannot be a child of <option>. This will cause a hydration error.' Radix instrumentation wraps dynamic text in a <span>, breaking native <select><option> semantics.
Console warning: 'DialogContent requires a DialogTitle for the component to be accessible for screen reader users.' Seen when Invoice preview modal opens after save.

integration_issues.flow: Close & New Frame on a multi-player session with NO linked main player
integration_issues.issue: Clicking 'Close & New Frame' after 'Fill Full' can return 400 'Credit requires a linked player' because the billable seconds tick up between preview and close, creating a tiny credit_amount > 0 while session.player_id is null. Fix options: (a) disable/warn Close & New Frame when session.player_id is null AND payer is not linked, (b) auto-refill full amount at submit-time on client, or (c) let server tolerate rounding-level shortfall for unlinked sessions.

action_items: Add `table_payer_id` query param to GET /api/sessions/{sid}/preview-bill so CloseTableModal preview reflects the selection (HIGH).
Guard 'Close & New Frame' button when session.player_id is null and credit would arise (or auto-recompute paid at click time).
Suppress hydration warning from Radix span-in-option (wrap option text as plain string, avoid dynamic expression wrap).
Add DialogTitle (VisuallyHidden if needed) to Invoice preview modal.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py:876 preview_bill signature missing table_payer_id — creates preview/close divergence (root cause of top UI bug).
CloseTableModal.jsx:44 refresh() effect depends on tablePayerId but never sends it to the API; consider passing manual client-side recompute instead of round-trip.

server.py compute_session_billing returns 'membership_percent' only via `mem_pct` variable but the field is referenced at close_session in invoice building (line 950). Verified functional in tests but tightly coupled — recommend a Pydantic response model.
walk_in_sale correctly returns invoice after popping _id; consistent Mongo ObjectId handling. Good.
AddPlayerToSessionReq: no validation that session is not already closed elsewhere — code checks status in handler; OK.
seed_data_creation: Created a few TEST_ prefixed players and one TEST_Snack inventory item (if none had stock>5). Left behind for future retest.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend regression file at /app/backend/tests/test_new_features.py — run with `REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL=... pytest ... -o addopts=''` (pytest.ini enables xdist which needs disabling for junit-only runs). Primary open item: preview-bill endpoint does not accept table_payer_id, causing the CloseTableModal per-player preview to lie about single-player table payment. Backend close still applies table_payer_id correctly so invoices are right — this is a preview-only display gap.

rca_of_the_issue.bug: Table Paid By selector shows no effect in Close & Bill preview.
rca_of_the_issue.reproduction: Login admin → Open table with 2+ players → optionally add a 3rd via Player button → Close & Bill → select 'Only <name> pays for table' in table-payer-select → observe per-player-* rows unchanged.
rca_of_the_issue.root_cause: GET /api/sessions/{sid}/preview-bill in /app/backend/server.py (~L876) does not accept table_payer_id; compute_session_billing therefore never sees `_table_payer_id` during preview. close_session (~L913) passes it in only at final commit.
rca_of_the_issue.mitigation: Add optional table_payer_id query param to preview_bill and pass it as `_table_payer_id` when calling compute_session_billing, mirroring close_session.
